create.title: Create product
create.intro: Specific fields only appear after selecting the product type.

basics.name: Product name
basics.nameHint: Between 3 and 80 characters. It must be unique within the same type.
basics.typeHint: The type determines which attributes are requested in the next step.
basics.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the product's story, function or identity within the game.
basics.imageHelp: JPG, PNG or WEBP; up to 5 MiB. The image is validated before it is linked to the product.

attrs.pickType: Go back to step 1 and select a product type.
attrs.subtypeHint: Separate several with commas. In UPPERCASE without spaces. E.g. GUERRERO, MAGO.
attrs.codeHint: In UPPERCASE without spaces. E.g. GUERRERO.
attrs.profileHint: The domain allows offensive or healer, never both at once.
attrs.setCodeHint: In UPPERCASE, or empty if it doesn't belong to a set.
attrs.addGeneralHint: It applies to any hero using the Epic; the specific one only to the compatible subtype.

effect.immunityHint: In UPPERCASE, no spaces. E.g. VENENO.
effect.statusHint: In UPPERCASE, no spaces. E.g. ATURDIDO.

magnitude.label: Magnitude
magnitude.amountHint: Whole number greater than or equal to 1.

pricing.availabilityHint: A limited print run stops being available when sold out; an infinite one never sells out.
pricing.infiniteBefore: No unit counter. The product will always remain
pricing.infiniteAfter: and each acquisition will only be recorded in the player's inventory.
pricing.unitsHint: Whole number greater than or equal to 1. It is the total that can be issued across the system.
pricing.creditsHint: Whole number greater than or equal to 0.
pricing.initialState: With this quantity the product will start as
pricing.premiumHint: Enables the real-money price. A premium product is locked from resale at Auction.
pricing.realMoneyHint: Whole number in the currency's minor unit. Minimum 1.

review.name: Name
review.note: On confirming, Catalog validates the attributes against the type's schema, stores the product and records the audit event. If anything fails, nothing is created.

adjust.reasonMin: The reason is required, at least {{min}} characters.
adjust.belowDelivered: It cannot be lower than the {{delivered}} units already delivered.
adjust.independent: Sold out and suspended are independent conditions: selling out doesn't change the product status, and reactivating it doesn't restock units.
adjust.suspendNote: The product will be suspended: it will no longer be available for new acquisitions and will disappear from the public showcase. It is not deleted —it stays intact in the inventory of those who already own it— and can be reactivated at any time.
adjust.reactivateNote: The product will be available again for new acquisitions and visible in the public showcase. If it was sold out, it will stay sold out until its print run is extended.
adjust.unitsHintMin: Whole number greater than or equal to {{min}}.
adjust.infiniteToLimited: An infinite print run product can't become limited: delivered units aren't counted, so there's nothing to check the minimum against.
